text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm out on a walk by
myself, I find
Hishi Amazon mulling over
something.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you. Listen, I want your advice
on
something. I've been having trouble
nailing my
sprint in the final stretch
lately.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I want to just blow past the pack, but I
keep
finding my way forward blocked
off.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think I should do when that
happens?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying I gotta beat the others
not just in
speed, but in spirit too, huh?
Yeah, that makes
sense.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I hate to admit it, but with the kind of
results I've
been getting lately, my
confidence might've
taken a hit.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right! Time to get more pumped than
ever and
get racin'!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
From the outside? Yeah, that could
work!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to cover more ground doing it
that way,
but that shouldn't be an issue
if I just run faster!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, I gotta buff up this body so
that I win
even from the outer track!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
First thing on my list is reassessing my
basic
training! Your daily efforts are
what pays off when
it matters, after all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the advice and getting me
outta that
rut! My next race'll be my
best yet! I can feel it!
